older adults are at risk from HIV/TB and that they need to be considered in HIV/TB policy and planning.

the HIV/AIDS epidemic is having a significant impact on mortality in the older population in rural South Africa.
the HIV/AIDS pandemic has a major impact on the older population in this area.
older people living in rural South Africa are disadvantaged in terms of their health, disability, social support and quality of life.
